dedupe_keys.name: amenagements cyclables sur les routes departementales

description: Aménagements cyclables sur les routes départementales is a dataset listed in Open Data Seine-Saint-Denis, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Seine-Saint-Denis. Ce jeu de données présente les caractéristiques des aménagements cyclables présents sur le patrimoine des voiries départementales. Cette version détaillée présente de nombreuses informations comme la nature de l'aménagement, le nom de la voirie de l'aménagement, le commençant finissant de l'aménagement, l'année de création, etc. Coverage: Seine-Saint-Denis. The portal files it under Spatial planning, Town planning, Buildings, Equipment, Housing. The portal shows 567 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-seinesaintdenis-fr-portal.
